Adds real signed receiver import, no-growth update, idempotent replay and 34-row refusal using only a guarded disposable database fixture.

Only oversized_entry_lists_fail_bounded changes: its budget follows 67 published definitions and independently requires 33 custom slots. Exact-bound, one-over, zero-budget and all hostile-input assertions remain.

boundaries.source: Relative to exact delivered head 3301618ab2be73b737fa2a2909ceb26152682b56, only two existing voice-off test functions and this manifest change. Captured observations are checked after awaited explicit database teardown; all 20 assertion macros retain their predicates and expected values, with the same fresh-collision query captured before teardown and a contextual expect in place of unwrap. boundaries.externalServices: No database, live Discord, staging or production mutation during authoring. Database-backed cases require the repository-guarded disposable TestDatabase service; HTTP effects use existing local doubles.
boundaries.runtime: Real parsing, role/access gates, actor command dispatch, service/transaction/import/replay paths and response rendering; command-only actors exclude unrelated timer maintenance.

contract.cap: Recorded UserCap and the four non-cap operator diagnostics remain byte-identical and context-free, with or without known owned rooms. No member-specific room IDs enter diagnostic dedup keys or notices.
contract.privacy: Narrowed: discovery returns channel references only. No row carries a privacy word or ACL classification, so retry bookkeeping, unknown overwrites and explicitly empty overwrites can neither hide a present owned channel nor mislabel it.
contract.singleSnapshot: Ready, halted and channel presence come from one live read guard. The deterministic test covers queued-read disconnect/reconnect ordering and new-generation results; it does not reproduce an intrafunction interleaving between synchronous guard acquisitions.
contract.configImport: Reject myroom command_roles entries in codec/import, preview and Confirm, including empty role lists. Runtime /access restrict also refuses myroom without a write and /access unrestrict myroom is a truthful no-op, so no writer can persist a myroom policy key.
contract.rollback: No myroom policy key can be persisted, so every runtime policy row stays previous-reader compatible and rollback needs no cleanup step.
contract.capacity: 33 noncolliding custom rows remain exportable/importable and manageable without growth. Voice off/on publication remains 45+33=78 and 67+33=100. Held assistant metadata reserves its name, not another publication slot. 34-row genuine overflow is refused with no partial transaction writes; internal import and replay use the same bound.
contract.legacyCustom: With automations on and voice off, saved pre-upgrade custom myroom continues to publish, dispatch, edit and pause/resume. With voice on, the voice slash handler wins. Fresh names remain safe and other saved customs remain usable.
contract.responseBound: 100 owned rooms with 19-digit IDs (unlabelled rows of 23 scalars) produce a completion input of at most 2000 scalars with complete rows and explicit omitted-room accounting, or an inspectable bounded complete UTF-8 room-list attachment. Exactly one private response and no room mutations remain required.
